kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننحصر (form VII)
# نَنْحَصِرُ (nanḥaṣiru) /nan.ħa.sˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# نَنْحَصِرَ (nanḥaṣira) /nan.ħa.sˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# نَنْحَصِرْ (nanḥaṣir) /nan.ħa.sˤir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
